justification: Caleb's Out, not Doubtful, not Questionable — that's the one tag that actually sits him, and it's exactly why Lock's on this roster instead of some game-manager off the wire; he starts, no drama. Skattebo put the ball on the ground in a loss two weeks back, and ball security in a loss is a character issue in this building — talent doesn't buy a pass on that, so he sits and Pollard steps in off the bench at 12+ a pop, no dropoff. Jeanty and Judkins stay up top because they're the backs who take the top off a defense, not the committee guys who never lose you eight but never win you twenty-eight. Downs, Burden, Kincaid, Reichard, and Detroit round it out — that defense just got embarrassed for negative two points and I'd rather they take that out on the Jets than take it out on my patience. We don't tank, we don't stream, we cobble a lineup from whatever's standing and we still play to win it.
forum_post: Caleb's Out and I'm not blinking — we rostered an arm for exactly this Sunday while the rest of you were writing essays. Dumbledore's talking about staircases and feet that watch them; fine, be curious, I'll be checking the score. See you Sunday.
